name: Forgejo
description: Forgejo is a lightweight, self-hosted Git forge (a fork of Gitea) with built-in CI/CD via Forgejo Actions. SETUP: After the first start, open the WebUI on port 3000 and complete the initial installation wizard. The default external SSH port is 222 (mapped to port 22 inside the container) so it does not conflict with Unraid's own SSH. For CI/CD, install the separate ForgejoRunner container and register it with this instance.

paths.name: Data Path
paths.description: Persistent storage for repositories, the SQLite database, configuration (app.ini), LFS objects, and attachments. Back up this directory regularly.

paths.name: Localtime
paths.description: Mounts the host timezone file so container timestamps match the Unraid timezone.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the Forgejo web interface.

ports.name: SSH Port
ports.description: Git over SSH. Host port 222 is used to avoid a conflict with the Unraid SSH server on port 22.

variables.name: USER_UID
variables.description: UID of the user inside the container. On Unraid this is normally 99 (nobody). Keep your previous value if you already have existing data.

variables.name: USER_GID
variables.description: GID of the group inside the container. On Unraid this is normally 100 (users). Keep your previous value if you already have existing data.
